scripts.build: npm run build -w @possible/packs && npm run build:consumers
scripts.build:consumers: npm run build -w @fraylabs/possible && npm run build -w @possible/mcp && npm run build -w @possible/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @possible/packs && npm run test -w @fraylabs/possible && npm run test -w @possible/mcp && npm run test -w @possible/web
scripts.discovery:evaluate: npm run build -w @possible/packs && npm exec -- tsx evaluations/discovery/verify.mjs
scripts.external-author:verify: npm run build -w @possible/packs && npm exec -- tsx evaluations/external-author/verify.mjs
scripts.packs:generate: node scripts/generate-pack-artifacts.mjs && npm run build -w @possible/packs && node scripts/sync-pack-reference.mjs && node apps/cli/scripts/sync-skill.mjs
scripts.packs:sync-reference: npm run build -w @possible/packs && node scripts/sync-pack-reference.mjs && node apps/cli/scripts/sync-skill.mjs
scripts.registry:sync: node scripts/generate-pack-artifacts.mjs && npm run build -w @possible/packs && node scripts/sync-registry-catalog.mjs && npm run build -w @possible/packs && node scripts/sync-pack-reference.mjs && node apps/cli/scripts/sync-skill.mjs
scripts.registry:validate: node scripts/generate-pack-artifacts.mjs --check && npm run build -w @possible/packs && node scripts/sync-registry-catalog.mjs --check && node scripts/validate-pack-reference.mjs
scripts.packs:check: node scripts/generate-pack-artifacts.mjs --check && npm run contract:validate && npm run test -w @possible/packs && npm run manifests:validate && node scripts/sync-registry-catalog.mjs --check && npm run pack-reference:validate
scripts.check: npm run lint && node scripts/generate-pack-artifacts.mjs --check && npm run contract:validate && npm run skill:validate && npm run routes:validate && npm run test && npm run manifests:validate && node scripts/sync-registry-catalog.mjs --check && npm run pack-reference:validate && npm exec -- tsx evaluations/external-author/verify.mjs && npm exec -- tsx evaluations/discovery/verify.mjs --enforce && npm run build:consumers && npm run publications:validate && npm run html:validate && npm run discovery:validate
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @possible/packs && npm run dev -w @possible/web
scripts.dev:mcp: npm run build -w @possible/packs && npm run dev -w @possible/mcp
